[Shot 1] The shot opens on <Picture 1> and holds the identical framing of <Picture 1> as a fully static shot on a fixed tripod with a prime lens, with the woman seated slightly right of centre and her hands loosely clasped in the lower foreground. Camera position, character-to-camera distance, focal length, field of view, headroom, subject scale and shoulder proportions match <Picture 1> exactly and stay constant for the whole clip; the framing and subject scale set by <Picture 1> at the first frame are never overridden by <Video 1>. <Subject 1> wears the white open-collar shirt with pushed-up sleeves and the silver flower pendant, and sits in front of the bright window with its soft-focus green foliage; nothing else appears in the frame besides <Subject 1>, <Subject 2> and <Subject 3>.
